scope.inspection: Source code and schemas; frozen author packets selected for sizes, keys, numeric profile projection and equality checks only. No corpus prose, candidate prose or reader judgments displayed or analyzed.
scope.unchanged: Frozen configurations, preparations, author requests, feedback, drafts and coordinator audit products. No network, model calls, implementation, commits or delegation.

revision.interpretation: The author disclosed incomplete consumption of the large first message. Saved exact request custody is not proof of complete model exposure.

evidence.byte_measurement: UTF-8 JSON using repository canonical_bytes conventions: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, trailing newline. No token estimate.

cause.finding: Every named feature and selected bigram stores 78 chapter rows, each repeating chapter, denominator, count and rate. Two layers times 337 records times 78 produces 52,572 rows; these row arrays account for approximately 91% of the author reference bytes.

_author_task embeds the full analytical reference_profile, not an author guidance projection. It only filters human_audit metadata. Exemplar prose is not the observed cause: the exemplar list is empty.

The existing diagnostic comparison strips repeated chapter rows from candidate comparisons and uses aligned columns once in reference_layers. That helper is not used by _author_task and still retains per-chapter values, so it is not a bounded aggregate author contract.

The preparation stores both task and serialized request; nested request strings add escaping overhead. Each revision retains the same oversized first message, then appends prior draft and feedback. These amplify rather than originate the size problem.

recommended_contract.selection: New explicitly opted-in study/preparation version; preserve existing v1 default and rendering exactly. Proposed support identifiers: backtest-statistical-support:v1 and style-reference-aggregate-support:v1, under the new protocol only.
recommended_contract.ceiling_definition: Serialized canonical workflow_support bytes, conservatively below both 64 KB and 64 KiB; validate before preparation or import and fail without truncation.
recommended_contract.shared_information: DIRECT and HARNESS retain byte-identical shared plan, entry state, entry facts, target length and budget, plus identical shared_information_sha256. DIRECT still has workflow_support=null. Compaction changes only HARNESS support.
recommended_contract.reference_scope: Keep exact included_chapters=1..78, excluded_chapters=[79,80], chapter_count=78 and existing feature selection scope. Derive only from the already holdout-filtered verified reference, never from candidate output or heldout measurements.
keep: dataset_ref, manifest_sha256, feature_set and complete feature_policy, including exploratory/not-target-blind word-list qualification, denominator/scale, bigram selection rules and quotation limitations
readiness, provisional, human_audit_status, the existing four-field author human_audit allowlist, and whole-dataset/not-separately-audited subset caveats
Each layer's aggregate han_characters, defined_chapters and total_chapters; quantile_method once
All 37 named features and the same 300 selected bigrams per layer, with exact count, aggregate rate_per_10k_han and chapter-distribution q1, median, q3
segmentation method, status, unknown_han_characters, unknown_han_fraction, issue_count and issue_counts_by_code
verdict=null, authority_effect=NONE, evidence_effect=NONE and the advisory editing rule

numeric_encoding.rows: Feature token maps to a five-value array under its existing feature group or top_han_bigrams map. Declare columns once; preserve exact numeric values, zeros and nulls without rounding. Shared chapter counts are layer-level because defined rates depend on that layer's denominator, not the feature.
numeric_encoding.guidance: Descriptive aggregate and interquartile guidance, not a literary threshold or evidence of superiority. Minimum and maximum are explicitly omitted from this new author-support contract, not from diagnostics.

exclude_from_author_support: Every chapter_distribution.chapters array and aligned per-chapter count/rate/denominator columns
Segmentation issue locators, chapter-by-chapter details and segment IDs; retain aggregate issue counts and adverse status
Raw corpus exemplars, excerpts, target text, target hashes/locators, chapter titles, candidate prose and reader judgments
recommended_contract.no_hidden_audit: Do not shrink by suppressing audit status or caveats. Leave full analytical profile, issue details and audit records available only through existing coordinator-side custody, unchanged. Author metadata filtering remains the existing safety boundary, not a new concealment policy. Shared factual task descriptions are unchanged; no raw source prose is added to support.
recommended_contract.traceability: Bind support schema/policy, source manifest, exact reference scope and compact-support digest into the new coordinator preparation/context. Keep full source closure and full-profile traceability coordinator-side; never hand authors an audit/path capable of retrieving heldout text.

size_feasibility.method: In-memory numeric/metadata projection of the frozen HARNESS profile; no replacement request or support artifact generated and no author/model run.
size_feasibility.finding: Deleting row arrays alone is insufficient. Removing redundant record keys through a declared five-column aggregate encoding gives a bounded contract without pruning the selected vocabulary or rounding retained statistics.
size_feasibility.limit_caveat: The 64 KB limit is for support, not an entire revision containing prior prose and feedback. If whole-request <=64 KB is separately required, this exact projection does not meet it for revisions; define another explicit version/budget rather than silently truncating or altering frozen history.

implementation_recommendation: Add a pure aggregate-support projection helper in /mnt/d/Code/RedChamberWorldHarness/src/rcwh/evaluation/style_reference.py. Do not change reference_profile, compare_reference or the full coordinator analytical profile.

Version-dispatch in /mnt/d/Code/RedChamberWorldHarness/src/rcwh/backtest/study.py and /mnt/d/Code/RedChamberWorldHarness/src/rcwh/backtest/session.py from an explicitly selected new config/preparation; absent selection renders legacy full support. New statistical-support mode disallows exemplar retrieval. Validate compact schema, deterministic bytes and the support byte ceiling before saving.

Use new versioned schemas and a separately selected config; do not rewrite /mnt/d/Code/RedChamberWorldHarness/data/backtest/front80-79-80/holdout.json, frozen packets or schemas bound by existing preparations. Fail closed on unknown support versions and unsupported combinations.

Compatibility includes source closure: session._preparation recomputes exact preparation bytes, and session._sources scans data/backtest recursively plus schemas/backtest_*.schema.json. Adding new files in those scanned locations or editing bound v1 schemas can stale legacy preparations even when requests are unchanged. Isolate v2 config/schema locations outside legacy scans or introduce tested version-aware immutable closure without weakening dependency checks.

required_tests.area: Backward compatibility and stable request comparison
required_tests.assertions: Legacy request bytes/hashes, preparation inputs and initial/revision packet regeneration remain identical without opt-in; actual frozen legacy preparation remains verifiable after adding v2 assets. New mode deterministically regenerates identical bytes/hashes. Version switching changes new support/context identity; forging support even with recomputed request hash fails exact comparison.

DIRECT/HARNESS shared objects, shared_information_sha256, target length and resource ceilings match exactly; no task field is lost. Canonical UTF-8 support <=64,000 bytes on the actual frozen numerical profile and stress fixtures; overflow fails without truncation. Initial and revision prefixes use the same compact support; total revision size is reported separately.

required_tests.area: Holdout exclusion and no raw prose
required_tests.assertions: Exact scope 1..78 excludes 79/80. Heldout-only sentinel words/bigrams never enter support; holdout changes do not affect reference numeric values or selections, while source-binding validation still detects changes. Reject heldout/any raw exemplar configuration in statistical-only mode. Recursively reject raw-text, excerpt, title, target-hash/locator, audit-note, issue-locator and per-chapter-detail fields.

Every retained count/rate/q1/median/q3 equals the full filtered profile, with the same 674 records and top-300 ordering/selection. Preserve zero/null and empty-layer semantics; no candidate-derived selection. Issue totals and code counts agree, adverse status/caveats survive, and full coordinator audit/profile remains unchanged. Validate support digest, schema/version, manifest/scope and source closure; changing any bound retained statistic or source fails lineage verification.

conclusion: The concrete cause is full analytical chapter-distribution serialization inside author support, not an unmet need for more literary design. A new opt-in aggregate numerical schema can reduce this observed support to approximately 50 KB. Size feasibility alone establishes neither full consumption, resource parity nor a workflow effect; old observations and consumption disclosure remain unchanged.
